svg.title: Fork Music inside
svg.desc: Native shell, local server and views, shared buying UI, Rust core, encrypted library and the store flows. 35 components and 32 flows.
svg.text: Native shell, local server and views, shared buying UI, Rust core, encrypted library and the store flows

g.title: Fork Music window — Built — Tauri window, single instance and updater; starts the bundled server and closes it on exit.
Bundled Music server — Built — Frozen Flask server inside the app; never reads the repository in a release build.
Lease enforcement — Built — Checks leases on start and every 10 minutes; purges keys, blocks and leases on expiry or revocation.
Native heartbeat — Built — Every 5 minutes: keep-alive, seed announce, session refresh and device certificate.
Music server (Flask) — Built — Local server on port 5021 with the session in memory and the refresh token in the Keychain.
Store — Built — Browse and search releases, open a release page and show the preview.
Library — Built — Owned licences, encrypted downloads, receipts and play buttons.
Passes — Built — WIP passes: verify the artist signature, create the lease and purge on a signed revocation.
Network settings — Built — Upload, download, storage and reach; chat is a placeholder until the backend exists.
Settings — Built — Account, terms, appearance and network in the shared Settings window.
Release page — Built — Release details, edition terms, preview and the Buy or Coming soon action.
Checkout — Building — Stripe Checkout through store_checkout; the switch is off and Buy says Coming soon.
Player — Built — Decrypted audio from memory through the shared player bar; the native engine is later.
Wallet and resale — Building — SIWS connect wallet, paid move back to Fork and resale only from custody.
Receipts — Built — Printable proof of acquisition with a QR code to forkgate.io/verify.
Session restore — Built — Reopens without a login by restoring the refresh token from the Keychain.
fork-ui-py — Built — Shared Python shell, legal, account, network limits and the player bar.
Shared buying UI — Built — Store, library, checkout, receipts, wallet and playback fragments.
Shared footer and player — Built — Footer and player bar: queue, scrub, now playing and the update button.
Fork account login — Built — Fork account login with the token only in memory and the refresh token in the Keychain.
Native bridge — Built — Local HTTP bridge with a random port and a secret per launch; keys, state and decrypted audio.
fan-delivery — Built — Buyer-side device key, leases, passes, native bridge and heartbeat.
core-p2p — Building — Rolling leases, chunker, block store, encrypted swarm and release protocol.
core-crypto — Built — Authorship, catalog, keys, AES-256 at rest and artist key backup.
core-cloud — Built — Supabase REST/RPC client, auth session and the buyer bridge.
core-chain — Building — Licence and edition terms plus Solana Bubblegum v2 transaction builders; devnet.
Supabase — Built — Postgres, Auth, Storage and Realtime: accounts, projects, versions, store and swarm records.
fork-signer — Built — Hot licence signer: Stripe queue, serials, Solana mint/transfer/freeze and key release; off by default.
P2P swarm — Building — Encrypted blocks on Fork computers and phones, three copies, direct transfers and release seeding.
Stripe — Building — Checkout, Tax and Connect Express payouts; test mode and the checkout switch is off.
Solana devnet — Building — Bubblegum v2 licences in one MPL Core collection; devnet only, no mainnet.
ForkMusicKeys — Built — Device seed and refresh tokens in one Keychain item.
Encrypted library — Built — FKR1 keys, FKB2 blocks, leases and terms; audio is decrypted only in memory.
Music data folder — Built — account.json, network.json, licences and the terms served to other fans.
P2P downloads — Built — Incoming release blocks from the artist, hosts and other fans, checked by cid.

svg.text: SHARED UI, LOGIN AND THE NATIVE BRIDGE
RUST CORE: DELIVERY, CRYPTO, NETWORK AND CLOUD
